info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Replace Loyalty Loyalty Transfer-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Transfer Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage loyalty points transfers between users. This API facilitates the updating of loyalty account information, allowing for seamless transfers of loyalty credits based on user requests. It is designed for loyalty program administrators and customer support teams who need to update transfers in real-time. Common use cases include resolving customer service inquiries and managing loyalty incentive programs.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to transfer loyalty points from one member to another within the loyalty program. Ensure you have the necessary permissions and that the source member has enough points to complete the transfer.

requestBody.description: Request body for transferring loyalty points between accounts. This operation allows users to specify the source and target accounts, along with the amount of points to be transferred. Ensure that both accounts have the necessary permissions and sufficient points before attempting the transfer.

200.description: The transfer request was successful and the resource has been updated.
